captureMethod: Live tools/list over OAuth using the dedicated directory-review fixture identity; public tool definitions only

tools.name: trackly_search_jobs
tools.title: Search jobs with trackly
tools.description: Search current trackly job openings. Results are account-scoped and never include referral intelligence.

tools.name: trackly_get_job
tools.title: Get job details
tools.description: Get the stored posting for one job ID without live employer-site hydration.

tools.name: trackly_search_companies
tools.title: Search tracked companies
tools.description: Search companies monitored by trackly.

tools.name: trackly_get_job_brief
tools.title: Get a job brief
tools.description: Get a role and company brief from a projection that never queries referral, contact, outreach, or networking data.

tools.name: trackly_get_preferences
tools.title: Get job preferences
tools.description: Read the user's current job discovery preferences.

tools.name: trackly_get_apply_readiness
tools.title: Check trackly Apply readiness
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Check profile, schema, approved queue, protocol, and current execution without returning sensitive values.

tools.name: trackly_lint_application_text
tools.title: Lint application text
tools.description: Deterministically validate application text length and flag likely contact data without storing or echoing the text.

tools.name: trackly_update_status
tools.title: Update job status
tools.description: Save, dismiss, or record a user-confirmed application status for one job.

tools.name: trackly_save_application_answers
tools.title: Save approved application answers
tools.description: Save only answers the user approved, using optimistic profile revision control. Education is an explicit replace-all operation: send the complete approved list with both replacement confirmations.

tools.name: trackly_grant_sensitive_storage_consent
tools.title: Allow encrypted sensitive-answer storage
tools.description: Grant explicit consent to store sensitive application answers encrypted. This does not add any answer by itself.

tools.name: trackly_revoke_sensitive_storage_consent
tools.title: Revoke sensitive-answer storage
tools.description: Revoke consent and delete stored sensitive or restricted answers through the backend two-step confirmation flow.

tools.name: trackly_list_apply_access_deferments
tools.title: List Apply access deferments
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). List this account's active job, company, and provider Apply access deferments. These preferences affect scheduling only and never assert that a portal requires authentication.

tools.name: trackly_defer_apply_access
tools.title: Defer Apply access for a job, company, or provider
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Idempotently defer one server-resolved job, its company, or its provider until explicitly cleared. Send only the Trackly job ID and scope; provider identity is derived server-side and blocks matching candidates before browser startup.

tools.name: trackly_clear_apply_access_deferment
tools.title: Clear an Apply access deferment
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Idempotently clear exactly one owner-scoped Apply access deferment so its job, company, or provider can be proposed again. Use only a deferment ID returned by the list tool; this never submits an application.

tools.name: trackly_start_or_resume_apply
tools.title: Start or resume trackly Apply
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Resume the active no-submit execution, or start a fixed target of approved jobs. If authorization changed, only executionId and revision are returned so trackly_stop_apply can clear the orphan securely before restart. It never clicks Submit.

tools.name: trackly_get_apply_work
tools.title: Get current Apply work
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Read authoritative Apply progress or a bounded execution snapshot. Server mutable flags and allowed operations are authoritative.

tools.name: trackly_report_apply_progress
tools.title: Report Apply progress or approve a resume
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Persist typed browser observations, exact-document resume approval only after explicit user consent, access dispositions, an explicit-user parked-member resume, or an execution advance. A preview is never upload approval. Record resume_attachment only after verifying the approved bytes and visible employer filename; record removed or failed if that changes. Ordering-v3 advances surface an immutable access-review proposal before browser work and accept only its exact ordered job IDs and approval hash. Never send answers, page text, credentials, OTPs, or CAPTCHA content.

tools.name: trackly_prepare_resume_artifact
tools.title: Preview your saved resume
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Preview the original default resume using operation preview. Opening the document does not approve employer upload or represent an attachment. Without an operation, returns manual upload instructions.

tools.name: trackly_certify_review_ready
tools.title: Mark an application ready for review
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Record that a run is ready for the user's manual review. This never submits the application.

tools.name: trackly_reconcile_manual_submission
tools.title: Reconcile a manual submission
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Only after explicit user confirmation or a visible success page, record that the user manually submitted. This tool cannot click Submit.

tools.name: trackly_stop_apply
tools.title: Stop trackly Apply
tools.description: Requires trackly Apply (apply:* scopes). Stop an Apply execution without submitting, closing browser tabs, or changing its immutable child batches.

tools.name: trackly_get_apply_progress
tools.title: Get authoritative Apply progress
tools.description: Get current execution progress and prepare its current work bindings. Omit executionId to recover the active execution. Server mutable flags and allowed operations remain authoritative.

tools.name: trackly_get_apply_snapshot
tools.title: Get an Apply member snapshot
tools.description: Get a bounded snapshot for exact members of one execution and only the requested profile keys. Server mutable flags and allowed operations remain authoritative.

tools.name: trackly_approve_apply_resume
tools.title: Approve an exact resume for Apply
tools.description: Record approval of the exact resume only after explicit user consent. A preview is not approval. This does not attach the resume or submit an application.

tools.name: trackly_bind_apply_surface
tools.title: Bind an Apply browser surface
tools.description: Bind the exact batch member and run to an initial or recovered browser surface using its current version and inspection epoch. This does not fill or submit an application.

tools.name: trackly_record_apply_dispositions
tools.title: Record Apply access dispositions
tools.description: Persist bounded live-probe access classifications for exact execution members. Send only typed classifications and fingerprints, never answers, page text, credentials, OTPs or CAPTCHA content.

tools.name: trackly_resume_parked_apply_member
tools.title: Resume a parked Apply member
tools.description: Resume one parked member only after an explicit user request. A fresh access probe is still required; this does not authenticate, fill or submit the application.

tools.name: trackly_record_apply_observations
tools.title: Record Apply browser observations
tools.description: Record bounded, redacted browser mechanics observations. Record resume attachment only after approved bytes and visible employer filename are verified. Never send answers, page text, credentials, OTPs or CAPTCHA content.

tools.name: trackly_advance_apply_execution
tools.title: Advance an Apply execution
tools.description: Advance the exact execution revision transactionally. Review a returned access proposal before browser work and approve only its exact ordered job IDs and hash. This never submits an application.

tools.name: trackly_prepare_resume_artifact
tools.title: Preview your saved resume
tools.description: Preview the original default resume using operation preview. Opening the document does not approve employer upload or represent an attachment. Without an operation, returns manual upload instructions.

tools.name: trackly_certify_review_ready
tools.title: Mark an application ready for review
tools.description: Record that a run is ready for the user's manual review. This never submits the application.

tools.name: trackly_reconcile_manual_submission
tools.title: Reconcile a manual submission
tools.description: Record a manual submission only after a visible success page or explicit user confirmation. For user_confirmation, explicitUserConfirmed must be true; for success_page, omit it. This tool cannot click Submit.

tools.name: trackly_stop_apply
tools.title: Stop trackly Apply
tools.description: Stop an Apply execution without submitting, closing browser tabs, or changing its immutable child batches.
